interpretation: Available-world diagnostics condition on passing estimation; missing worlds prevent unconditional coverage claims.
Matched comparisons reuse identical outer worlds, truth and financial budgets; comparisons across grid cells are not independent.
Positive interval width is not itself improvement; lower interval score and Brier are better.
Wait-zero deposit requirements may be impossible. Extended-real required-deposit coverage (infinity<=infinity) is not a feasible saving recommendation.
Small outer batches and 16-refit pilot mixtures do not establish calibrated tails or a universal estimator winner.
